2609.11347.title: Reification as a Transferable Vocabulary: Zero-Shot Link Prediction with Vanilla GNNs
2609.11347.paper_summary: Knowledge graph foundation models such as ULTRA achieve zero-shot link prediction on unseen graphs through dedicated architectures that hard-code a transfer mechanism. In this work we move that mechanism out of the architecture and into the representation, by \emph{reifying} the input graph: every fact becomes a node, connected to its subject, object, and relation type through a fixed vocabulary of six meta-relations, with relation types as anonymous shared nodes rather than model parameters. On this representation, five textbook GNNs (GAT, GINE with sum and with mean+max aggregation, GraphSAGE, R-GCN), each trained on a single knowledge graph of 4,245 triples for 30 minutes on one NVIDIA A100, transfer zero-shot to 40 inductive link-prediction benchmarks. The best of them, an off-the-shelf GAT, matches ULTRA, a dedicated foundation model pretrained on three graphs, across ULTRA's own evaluation suite. The same fixed vocabulary extends to relational databases, a row becoming an entity and a foreign-key column a relation type; a preliminary probe on two unseen databases, with no cell values, schema text or in-context labels, shows a model of this family pretrained on three knowledge graphs ranking foreign-key targets far above random-initialization and degree controls. We release the code, the checkpoints, and the evaluation pipeline for all 40 benchmarks.
2609.11347.paper_summary_zh: 知識圖譜基礎模型如ULTRA透過專門的架構實現對未見圖的零樣本連結預測，這些架構硬編碼了一個轉移機制。在這項工作中，我們將該機制從架構中移出，轉移到表示中，通過\emph{具象化}輸入圖：每個事實都成為一個節點，通過固定的六個元關係詞彙連接到其主體、客體和關係類型，關係類型作為匿名共享節點而非模型參數。在這種表示上，五個教科書級的GNN（GAT、GINE（使用總和和均值+最大聚合）、GraphSAGE、R-GCN），每個模型在一個包含4,245個三元組的知識圖上訓練30分鐘，能夠零樣本轉移到40個歸納連結預測基準中。其中表現最佳的，為一個現成的GAT，與ULTRA（在三個圖上預訓練的專用基礎模型）在ULTRA自己的評估套件中匹配。相同的固定詞彙擴展到關係數據庫，一行成為一個實體，外鍵列成為一個關係類型；對兩個未見數據庫的初步探測，沒有單元格值、模式文本或上下文標籤，顯示這個家族的模型在三個知識圖上預訓練，對外鍵目標的排名遠高於隨機初始化和度數控制。我們釋放所有40個基準的代碼、檢查點和評估管道。
2609.11347.author: Camille Pradel et.al.
